def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    x = int(input_data[0])
    y = int(input_data[1])
    if x > y:
        x, y = y, x
    if x == 1:
        mod = y % 6
        if mod == 0:
            print(y)
        elif mod == 1:
            print(y - 1)
        elif mod == 2:
            print(y - 2)
        elif mod == 3:
            print(y - 3)
        elif mod == 4:
            print(y - 2)
        else:
            print(y - 1)
    elif x == 2:
        if y == 2:
            print(0)
        elif y == 3:
            print(4)
        elif y == 7:
            print(12)
        else:
            print(y * 2)
    else:
        if (x * y) % 2 == 1:
            print(x * y - 1)
        else:
            print(x * y)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
